evidence: log loss +0.0157 (95% interval +0.0065 to +0.0239). The model's probabilities are WORSE than the market's closing probabilities (the interval is above zero).

293 picks, ROI +2.6% (95% interval -6.2% to +11.2%), win rate 61.1% against a break-even 58.9%. Random sides at the same margin match or beat this 7% of the time. Line movement toward the pick after it was made: +0.14 probability points on average (zero means no closing-line value).
How many bets before ROI can be trusted

At the observed spread of results, detecting a true 3% ROI takes about 4,820 bets and a 5% ROI about 1,735; a 1% edge takes 43,373. Closing-line value converges much faster, which is why it is the primary measure.
